scope: Read-only full raw capture scan, limited to FIA/recurrent/chunk GDN; no full-model runtime replay, graph export or capture modification outside the declared local replay.

runtime.profiler_contract_changes: uncommitted at this local acceptance; exact relevant file hashes recorded

aggregation.basis: Distinct (capture SHA, native type, complete compared tensor contract); new alternatives must be disjoint from each other and retained dense baseline.

limitations: Context length and phase are caller declarations, not inferred from tensor count, cache capacity or observed duration. q1/q2/q4 do not prove draft or verify identity.

The paged projection compares native type, Q/O descriptors, cache block size/packed row width/dtype/format and table batch count. Cache capacity, table/sequence values, scalar flags and packed KV-head factorization are excluded.
Alternative declarations reuse one capture. Whole scenario event counts and timing totals must not be added; only distinct tensor-contract cohorts are combined here.

ChunkGatedDeltaRuleFwd 156 A3 events now expose a validated legacy 9-input/4-output full native ABI, but generic sim TND/BF16-state chunk wrapper does not establish the captured BHTD/FP32-state native boundary. Its complete contract remains unmatched; no member costs or layer identities are invented.
Recurrent BF16 operands and BF16/FP32 state are the supported native dtype boundary; a declared FP16 recurrent operand produces no contract.
No draft model graph or unobserved MTP step cost is added. No source file proves identity with the capture binary.
